class_descriptions.Normal Beat: Normal sinus rhythm; no abnormal conduction pattern detected.
class_descriptions.Supraventricular Ectopic (SVEB): Atrial/junctional premature contraction originating above ventricles.
class_descriptions.Premature Ventricular (PVC): Ventricular ectopic beat originating in ventricles (wide QRS).
class_descriptions.Other Arrhythmia: Ventricular fusion, paced rhythm, or unclassified cardiac pattern.
